parsed.why: Worst-policies tier: criminal bathroom misdemeanour, K-12 facility ban, religious healthcare refusal, no state discrimination or hate-crime cover; adds hostile layer atop national document regime with thin recourse.

Statewide public-accommodations and hate-crime protection covering gender identity, panic-defence repeal, low-risk tier; restrictions confined to schools. Visitor-facing protections operate, but national passport and entry regime still applies.

No division-specific visitor restriction; violence counts lack denominators (undercount floor unusable) and adult care cancellation is resident-facing. Local regime roughly tracks the hostile national baseline, slightly worse.

Protective machinery documented working: facility access by identity, hate-crime enforcement, courts ordering care resumed, refuge protections, top-tier assessment. National document/entry regime caps the score despite strong local shields.

Broad 2025 binary-sex facility statute covering bathrooms, locker rooms, shelters, dorms, prisons; religious-refusal immunity permits service denial; no statewide protection, worst-law tier, narrow document route with court refusals.
